estimate.title: What has your family taken on?
estimate.body: Estimate the money your family spent absorbing problems connected to active addiction. Rough numbers are enough. This is information—not a judgment.
estimate.privacy: Private by design: amounts stay on this screen and are not saved or sent.
estimate.empty: Enter at least one amount to continue.

categories.title: Living expenses you took over
categories.body: Bills and everyday costs that shifted from them to you.

items.label: Housing
items.hint: Rent, mortgage, hotel stays, or the value of living in your home without contributing

items.label: Food, gas, and daily spending
items.hint: Groceries, meals, fuel, and repeated small requests

items.label: Vehicles and transportation
items.hint: Payments, insurance, repairs, rides, or replacement transportation

categories.title: Financial rescues
categories.body: Money used to solve an immediate problem or prevent a consequence.

items.label: Cash, transfers, and loans
items.hint: Money handed over, sent electronically, or expected to be repaid

items.label: Debts you paid
items.hint: Credit cards, overdue accounts, or money owed to other people

items.label: Fines, towing, and release costs
items.hint: Tickets, impound fees, bail, or similar expenses

categories.title: Consequences paid by the family
categories.body: Costs that reached your household after something went wrong.

items.label: Legal and court costs
items.hint: Attorneys, filings, hearings, or other legal expenses

items.label: Damaged, lost, or replaced property
items.hint: Home repairs, vehicles, electronics, or other belongings

items.label: Money or valuables not returned
items.hint: Include losses you may not have previously counted

reflection.title: See the pattern clearly
reflection.projectionLabel: If the same pattern continued for five years
reflection.context: This number does not measure how much you care. It reflects the ways you tried to keep someone safe or keep the family functioning. You can use it now to decide where your support will go next.
reflection.fundTitle: What are you still willing to fund?
reflection.fundBody: Choose support that points toward health, safety, or recovery.

fundOptions.label: Treatment or an assessment paid directly to the provider
Medical care or medication paid directly
Food or necessities I purchase myself
Help approved with a coach, counselor, or trusted family partner

reflection.pauseTitle: What will require a pause or a no?
reflection.pauseBody: Select the requests you do not want to answer under pressure.

pauseOptions.label: Debts, fines, or legal costs caused by continued use
Recurring bills I have repeatedly taken over
Replacing property after preventable damage or loss
Any money request that demands an immediate answer

reflection.boundaryBody: Make it about what you will do. Keep it short enough to say when emotions are high.
reflection.boundaryPlaceholder: Example: I will not give cash. I can pay a treatment provider directly.
reflection.selectionNeeded: Choose at least one item or write a boundary to continue.

plan.title: A clearer answer for the next request
plan.willPause: I will pause or say no to
plan.nextStep: You do not have to defend this plan in the middle of a crisis. Review it with someone you trust, then practice saying the boundary calmly.
plan.sharePause: I will pause or say no to:

disclaimer: For personal reflection and education only—not financial, legal, or medical advice. If anyone is in immediate danger, call 911. Call or text 988 for crisis support.
